name: mirage
text: It was not on because the engine had stopped its own ordering at 18:06 UTC (fills unreadable under Novig's rate limit) and stays stopped until a restart. I have now restarted the engine (18:26 UTC) on the new code, which clears that stop. v1.0.99 is on main: about half as many bids (cap 400, 125 a pass), double the stake per bid, and a resting bid is re-posted only after the fair rises 4 steps instead of 2. Your money limits and the EV floors are unchanged. Its APK build is running now. About your toggles: live betting reads as off. Kalshi, SX Bet, PropLine, ParlayAPI and Novig sockets are on, but the BoltOdds, SharpAPI and Pinnodds sockets are still off in your settings. If you want BoltOdds on, say so. I will confirm in a few minutes that the engine started and orders are going.
